description: Edit ONLY the lower architectural footing of each existing slotted broken stone column. Preserve the original broken upright shafts, slots, cracks, native pixel density, scale, palette, upper 76 rows and position exactly. Replace the separate tall dark cube-like shoes in the lower quarter with one integrated low bearing course of weathered blue-gray cut stone. Make the foundation visibly SHALLOWER: a broad clearly visible horizontal top plane and only a short 3-pixel high vertical front face. The near front edge runs left-to-right, depth recedes north, bevelled/chipped corners. The two upright piers must emerge convincingly from their shared bearing masonry with no black separation seam at the shaft join. Keep the footing within x10..53 and finish on the same frontmost row99, leaving clear bottom margin. Quiet chipped surfaces and a few purposeful mortar joints, the same ash slate material as the floor. Reduce the heavy dark outline at the foot to a selective fine contact edge; no bright continuous bevel rail. Preserve the distinctive existing tall slotted engineering ruin. Transparent64x112 canvas; no surrounding floor patch, cast shadow, rubble, moss, plants, ornaments, resizing or camera change. This is a foundation redraw, not a recolor.
